title: Crooked vegetable box
description: Carrots, kale and potatoes from Plot 4, picked the morning you collect. Each box has enough for a few meals for two people; the exact mix depends on what is ready. The carrots have personality and occasionally look like they are trying to leave. Please message me the day before so I can set a box aside, and bring a basket or bag. Collection is at the allotment gate on Saturday morning. Happy to swap a little kale for extra potatoes if the harvest allows. Everything comes unwashed, with a small souvenir of the allotment attached.

title: Wanted: repair my wheelbarrow
description: The wheel squeaks in B flat. Looking for someone to replace its bearing before the next harvest.

title: Friday sourdough loaves
description: Slow-fermented wheat loaves, baked Friday morning with a good crust and a soft middle. Please reserve by Thursday evening; my oven is enthusiastic but small. The offer is for one loaf, collected at Mill Lane between 8 and 11. Bring a cloth bag if you have one. Contains gluten; ask me about other allergens before reserving.

title: Wanted: clean jam jars
description: Seeking twelve clean wide-necked jars with lids for starter portions. No mystery contents, please.

title: Bicycle tune-up
description: If your bike changes gear only after a polite negotiation, bring it to the station shed. I'll adjust the brakes and gears, clean and lubricate the chain, and check the tyres, wheels and fixings. This covers a routine tune-up for one bicycle; replacement parts are separate and we'll agree those before I fit anything. Please send a short message about the bike and any particular grumbles, ideally with a photo, so I can check I have the right tools. Allow about an hour and book a time before coming over. You're welcome to stay and learn a few basic checks, or leave it with me and collect later. Everyday bikes are very welcome, including the one that has been behind the lawnmower since spring.

title: Wanted: apples for chutney
description: Looking for a basket of cooking apples. Bumps welcome; inhabitants less so.

title: Young fruit-tree pruning
description: An hour of careful pruning and advice for young apple or pear trees. Send me a photo and a rough height first, and we'll arrange a suitable time for the tree as well as for us. I bring hand tools and explain what I am doing as we go, so you can tackle the next tidy-up yourself. Reachable branches only; my enthusiasm for orchards does not extend to circus work. We'll leave the cuttings in a neat pile for your compost or collection.

title: Wanted: mend a canvas apron
description: The pockets are trying to resign. Could someone patch two seams in my orchard apron?

title: Hand-thrown breakfast mug
description: Stoneware mug with a comfortable handle and blue glaze. Holds about 300 ml, depending on how urgently you need tea. Dishwasher safe; each one is slightly different. Message me to choose from the current batch and arrange collection. Please bring a little wrapping for the journey home.

title: Wanted: packing boxes
description: Small sturdy boxes and clean paper wanted for pottery. Newspaper headlines may be dramatic; boxes must not be.

title: Beginner acoustic guitar lesson
description: A relaxed 45-minute lesson at the village hall for anyone starting from scratch or returning after a long pause. We'll cover tuning, a couple of chords and a simple rhythm, then try a song you actually like. No need to read music. I have a spare acoustic guitar; please mention when booking if you would like to borrow it for the session. Bring a song idea and whatever questions you have. Squeaky chords are part of the process, and there is absolutely no compulsory performance at the village fete.

title: Wanted: bicycle puncture repair
description: My front tyre has retired unexpectedly. Looking for a patch and a quick lesson in doing it myself.

title: Sheep fleece for spinning
description: One skirted raw fleece from this year's shearing. Collect from Thistle Farm; bring a sack and expect lanolin.

title: Wanted: extra hands for hay stacking
description: Two people for an hour in the dry barn. Gloves recommended; tea and biscuits included.

title: Seasonal vegetable soup portions
description: Four chilled portions of hearty vegetable soup. Ask about ingredients and allergens; bring suitable containers.

title: Wanted: sharpen kitchen knives
description: Three kitchen knives need an edge. At present the carrots are winning.

title: Wobbly chair repair
description: Reglue loose joints and make your wooden chair steady again. Bring it to my shed for a look first.

title: Wanted: lift to the timber yard
description: Need a lift for myself and a short bundle of timber next Tuesday. No roof-balancing adventures.

title: An hour of dog walking
description: A small group walk along the brook. Meet first to discuss temperament and recall; maximum three dogs.

title: Wanted: waterproof jacket repair
description: A small tear in a good raincoat needs patching. The weather has noticed.

title: Autumn salad seedlings
description: A tray of six hardy salad plants, with growing notes. Suitable for a bed or deep window box.

title: Wanted: borrow a fruit press
description: Looking to borrow a clean apple press for one weekend. Returned scrubbed, with a bottle of juice.

title: Trouser hemming and small repairs
description: Shorten one pair of trousers or mend a simple seam. Bring clean garments; fitting by appointment.

title: Wanted: two sourdough loaves
description: Two loaves for the costume group's Saturday lunch. Crusty bread encouraged; crumbs will become scenery.

title: Patient phone or laptop help
description: One hour for backups, video calls or everyday settings. Bring your device and charger; we will write down the steps.

title: Wanted: indoor plant cuttings
description: Rooted cuttings for my bright windowsill. Ideally something that tolerates a missed watering.

title: Seasonal garden bouquet
description: A hand-tied bunch of whatever is looking lovely this week. Collect Friday; colours vary with the garden.

title: Wanted: repair a garden gate
description: The small gate needs rehanging. It currently opens in three directions, only one of them useful.

title: Sharpen secateurs or shears
description: Clean and sharpen one pair of garden secateurs or hand shears. No powered tools; allow two days.

title: Wanted: beginner guitar lesson
description: I can tune a lawnmower but not a guitar. Looking for a patient first lesson.

title: Seed-saving workshop
description: An hour for up to four neighbours: drying, labelling and storing easy seeds. Meet in the library annex.

title: Wanted: a sturdy bookcase
description: A low bookcase for the seed library. Cosmetic scratches welcome; structural surprises less welcome.

title: Village cargo-bike delivery
description: One local collection and delivery, up to 15 kg. Weather permitting; no livestock or grand pianos.

title: Wanted: soup for a volunteer lunch
description: Four portions of vegetable soup for Saturday's repair crew. Containers supplied and happily returned.

title: Hand-knitted wool socks
description: Warm adult socks in natural wool. Choose from available sizes; hand-wash instructions included.

title: Wanted: raw sheep fleece
description: One clean-ish skirted fleece for spinning practice. I accept that sheep are not upholstered furniture.

title: Bramblewick history walk
description: A gentle 90-minute village walk, including the mill and old railway. Step-free route available on request.

title: Wanted: borrow folding chairs
description: Six folding chairs for a history evening. Returned next day, with all six accounted for.

title: Oat and raisin biscuits
description: A dozen home-baked biscuits. Contains oats, wheat, eggs and dairy; collect on Saturday morning.

title: Wanted: help with a phone backup
description: My photos live somewhere inside this rectangle. I would like a second copy somewhere less mysterious.

title: Put up a shelf
description: Install one shelf on a suitable wall. Fixings and location agreed beforehand; shelf supplied by you.

title: Wanted: a pot for a large fern
description: A sturdy plant pot around 30 cm wide. The fern has outgrown both its pot and its modesty.

title: Gentle chair yoga session
description: A calm 45-minute class with seated options. Bring water; tell me about any movements you want to avoid.

title: Wanted: fresh flowers for the hall
description: A small bunch for the welcome table on Friday. Something cheerful that will not overwhelm the hay-fever contingent.

title: Apple and onion chutney
description: A 250 g jar from the autumn batch. Ingredients and allergens on the label; return the empty jar if you can.

title: Wanted: spare cooking apples
description: A bucket of sound windfalls for chutney. Slightly odd shapes are practically a requirement.

title: Willow basket repair
description: Repair a handle or a small damaged section on a willow basket. Send a photo before dropping it off.

title: Wanted: lend me secateurs
description: Sharp bypass secateurs for a morning's willow cutting. Returned clean and grateful.

title: Build a simple insect hotel
description: A small habitat box made with reclaimed untreated wood and hollow stems. Includes siting advice.

title: Wanted: mend work trousers
description: Two knee patches for my favourite work trousers. The trousers and I have both seen better fences.

title: Conversational Spanish practice
description: A relaxed hour of Spanish conversation for beginners. Coffee, useful phrases and no surprise grammar exams.

title: Wanted: bicycle tune-up
description: Brakes and gears checked before autumn rides. I would prefer the squeaking to come from actual wildlife.

title: Holiday houseplant visits
description: Two local visits to water indoor plants and check agreed tasks. Meet first and leave clear care instructions.

title: Wanted: a warm pair of socks
description: Wool socks, adult size 39, for a draughty cottage. Matching colours are a bonus rather than a condition.

title: Lift to the weekly market
description: Return trip to the Wednesday market, up to two passengers. Meet at the village hall at 9; bags welcome.

title: Wanted: fresh salad seedlings
description: Six hardy seedlings for a raised bed. My last attempt became a private buffet for slugs.

title: Hand-painted garden sign
description: A short name or message on reclaimed timber, sealed for outdoor use. Lettering and size agreed first.

title: Wanted: a beginner pottery lesson
description: Would like to make a bowl that stays a bowl. All previous attempts have become abstract landscapes.

title: Small meeting room for an hour
description: Room for up to twelve people, with kettle, accessible entrance and chairs. Book ahead; leave it as you found it.

title: Wanted: help stack chairs after lunch
description: Two neighbours for half an hour after Sunday's lunch. Tea provided; chair-stacking championships optional.
